evaluation_ontology: Primary ontology = 'rock' (any visible rock whose box is >= ~50 px area at 720x480, i.e. what POLAR-Sim labels on NASA images). The S1 baseline predicts 'large_rock' (a renderer size class, not an apparent-size class); when it is scored against 'rock' ground truth, report recall per box-size bin and do not read low small-rock recall as a model failure. On synthetic held-out data score both models against both label sets (S1 and S2-H). On NASA use the 92-image exposure-selected subset, rock class only.
evidence_summary: S1 CSV boxes come from the strict blue (physically large) mask class: 97% (66,430/68,560) of unboxed blue components are < 21 px in width or height; CSV boxes are geometrically valid and separate touching boulders that the semantic mask merges.

S1 is semantically incomplete for obstacle avoidance: in 41 of 62 assessed candidate-subset scenes S1 misses clearly visible rocks (13 partial, 8 no). 'large' is a 3D-size class: 28,519 green components in the candidate subset are larger in the image than the median CSV box (1,836 px^2), versus 17,685 CSV boxes in total.
S2 recovers missed rocks (45/62 scenes yes, 12 partial) and boxes are mostly tight (55 mostly, 5 yes, 2 no); no split-of-one-rock cases observed at scene level, but merges in 18/62 scenes.

Per-candidate review (AI assistant, 86 additional S2 candidates >= 50 px): 50 visible rocks (58%), 16 merged groups (19%), 18 ambiguous (21%), 2 not visible. Below 50 px only 5/16 (31%) are visible rocks -> 50 px minimum area. Green 50-100 px: 13/16 (81%).

S2 large-rock components are worse than S1: blue components >= 1000 px without a CSV box were merged rock groups in 9/10 reviewed cases; 3,034 of 3,177 'uncertain' CSV boxes cover part of a larger merged mask region.
Morphological closing hurts: V2 lowers CSV match rate 0.837 -> 0.801 and increases merged components 1,705 -> 1,898; cyan assignment (V1) reduces split CSV boxes 477 -> 350 at +2% merges.

Uncertain CSV boxes (46 reviewed): candidate-subset strata are mostly valid boxes the matcher missed (of 28 clean items: 12 matcher failure + 4 imperfect mask = 16 valid, 10 undetermined, 2 annotation errors); anomaly strata are frame mismatches (6/6) or corrupted-mask errors (5/6 cam_anomaly); shadow strata undeterminable (6/6).
Terrain06: UNVERIFIED_NEGATIVE (8 apparently rock-free, 2 rock-like/ambiguous, 8 unusable of 18 reviewed images); POLAR-Sim segmentation of terrain06 contains only background/ground polygons.

Dark exposures: POLAR-Sim rock boxes are identifiable after contrast enhancement at 16-64 ms (automated proxy: 90% / 72% / 28% 'visible only enhanced' at 16/32/64 ms), but not in a fixed 12->8-bit view; 1024-2048 ms clips sunlit rocks. Exposure-selected subset: 92 images, 96.5% of rock boxes visible in fixed view.
limitations: All visual verdicts are the AI assistant's assessment at display resolution, not human validation; small-rock judgements on 190-px crops are uncertain.
Candidate review strata are not proportional to the population; pass rates must not be averaged into a dataset-wide precision, and no confidence interval is claimed.
The visibility proxy (contrast/darkness) is weak: 111/114 reviewed candidates were 'ok' but only 59% of those were visible rocks.
The split rule for merged green components is not designed yet; S2-H as specified still contains ~19% merged boxes among additional candidates.
S2-H roughly 24x the box count of S1 (46.1 vs 1.9 boxes per image) -> much denser, harder training target; effect on YOLO is unmeasured.
No human has reviewed the NASA exposure policy, Terrain06 or the uncertain boxes.
required_human_reviews: Confirm or reject the ontology decision 'rock' (vs 'large_rock') - it changes what the rover will detect.
Review >= 20 comparison sheets in gallery/index.html (filter: candidate subset) and fill reviewer_decision for S1/S2 rows.
Spot-check s2_mask_overlays/candidate_review/candidates_0[1-3].jpg to confirm the 50 px threshold.
Approve the NASA exposure-selection policy (92 images) and the 12->8-bit conversion choice for evaluation.
Approve proceeding to AI-01.C (build S2-H with merged-component splitting) - training stays unauthorised.

s2_extraction_policy.distant_large_rocks: V1_cyan blue components 50..999 px not >=50% inside a CSV box, visibility proxy ok (CSV omits rocks below ~21 px)
s2_extraction_policy.frames: candidate subset only (exclude the 573 anomaly-listed frames)
s2_extraction_policy.large_rocks: S1 CSV instance boxes (NOT blue-mask components: the semantic mask merges touching boulders; 9/10 reviewed blue components >=1000px without CSV box were merged rock groups)
s2_extraction_policy.name: S2-H (hybrid label set to be built and validated in AI-01.C)
s2_extraction_policy.small_medium_rocks: V1_cyan green components >= 50 px, visibility proxy ok; needs split-of-merged-components step before use
s2_extraction_policy.variant: V1_cyan (cyan edge pixels -> large rock; no morphological closing)
